name: MEGA-FLARE
description: This deposit contains the synthetic benchmark datasets, source code and trained model weights for MEGA-FLARE (McIntosh-class, Ensemble-based, GOES-Augmented Flare Learning And Real-time Estimation). It accompanies the article "A Cross-Validated Ensemble Neural Network Framework for McIntosh- and GOES-Augmented Short-Term Solar Flare Prediction" by Zraqou, Alnsour, Alrousan and Alqatawnah, submitted to AI (MDPI). MEGA-FLARE re-implements the neural-network stage of the Automated Solar Activity Prediction (ASAP) system (Colak & Qahwaji, 2009). It extends that stage with a background GOES X-ray flux input, k-fold cross-validated hidden-layer selection, nine-member bootstrap-aggregated ensembles, and decision-threshold calibration by maximizing the Heidke Skill Score. Important: all datasets are synthetic. They were generated with a documented, probabilistically calibrated process that reproduces qualitative patterns from the sunspot-classification and flare-association literature. They are not NGDC, NOAA or GOES observational records, and results obtained on them do not indicate real-world forecasting skill. The deposit includes: Datasets: a training/validation catalog of 8,000 records and an independent test catalog of 4,000 records (CSV). Each record holds the McIntosh class, sunspot-group area, simulated GOES flux, the generator's true flaring probability, flare occurrence and flare class (C, M or X).
